stages.label: Juvenile
stages.caption: An open, coiled beginning.
stages.description: The illustration exposes the coiled form. It is a conceptual life stage, not a dated reconstruction.

stages.label: Developing
stages.caption: Building at the opening.
stages.description: The changing form emphasizes the shell opening, where extension occurs. The slider does not represent elapsed time.

stages.label: Subadult
stages.caption: The adult form emerges.
stages.description: The opening narrows and the lip becomes more prominent in this simplified illustration.

stages.label: Mature adult
stages.caption: A familiar form. An unknown age.
stages.description: Adult form is a maturity cue, not a birthday. The shell does not give this demo a defensible exact age.
